answer: Each epoch, a randomly drawn peer cross-examines every answer by asking its author to defend one specific claim that account made in an earlier epoch. The reply must stay consistent with that account's own history yet not match any other account's replies. One honest agent keeps one story; a farm of n fakes must keep n separate histories and check each new reply against n-1 siblings, so its bookkeeping grows roughly with n squared. Like shale under load, a nebula of clones that shares one pigment of reasoning splits along the same seam once questioned.
